labels: piece of the triangular lattice: a regular hexagon, its centre, and two adjacent points of the next ring
piece of the triangular lattice: rows of 1, 3, 3 and 2 points

three equilateral triangles with a common centre and parallel sides (Erdős–Fishburn’s description; 3-fold symmetry about (0, −1/√3)). Equivalently: square ABCD (side √2); on sides AD and CD the outward equilateral apexes H, I and the inward apexes F, G of isosceles triangles with apex angle 150°; E on the axis beyond D with DE = DF = √3 − 1. Distances √3−1, √2, 2, √3+1 (the 12-gon chords c₁, c₂, c₃, c₅).
